edge_types.designed_to_probe: item -> construct hypothesis; NOT evidence that the construct is established
edge_types.elicited_associate: trial -> concept; cue, context and rank retained
edge_types.evokes: cue concept -> associate concept; context-specific estimated inclusion rate
edge_types.preferred_similarity: cue -> selected candidate; conditioned on exact comparison set
edge_types.rated_on: concept -> semantic axis or trial-specific elicited distinction
edge_types.implies_simulated_state: trial -> task-defined state; not a real action

identity.concept: casefold and collapse whitespace only; no punctuation, synonym, sense, or embedding merges
identity.trial: run_id + item_id + repeat; run IDs must be globally unique across merged datasets
identity.configuration: hash of recorded configuration including system prompt; not a guarantee of provider-side reproducibility
identity.edge: hash of endpoints, relation and all attributes; exact duplicate edges suppressed

weights.evokes: valid trials mentioning associate / valid trials for SAME cue, context, configuration and run; each list counts once; outgoing weights need not sum to 1
weights.preferred_similarity: choice count / valid responses for SAME cue and exact comparison set
weights.rated_on: mean raw rating on explicit 0..6 scale; not interchangeable with probability
weights.scored_as: measurement value has a metric-specific unit; no generic probability weight

missingness: Unobserved pairs are absent, not zeros. Explicitly offered unchosen SIM candidates have measured zero support. Missing, declined, invalid and API-error trials remain distinct.
graphdiff: Not a drop-in graphdiff file. Export a specified layer and context with scalar attributes and a unique (source,type,target) key. Aggregate repeated observations first. Do not flatten provenance or mixed conditions into one edge.
